metadata.note: DELEGATECALL to an attacker-deployed contract that reconfigured the Safe in the same transaction that drained it, so no delay or review window ever applied to the settings change. Fails R-4.2: a delegatecall that changes Safe storage outside the signedMessages exception. Also fails R-4.1, since the singleton implementation address is a Safe setting (§ 2.10) and a delegatecall to a non-Safe target cannot meet R-4.1's allowed exceptions.
